summary: Thailand allocates 3.5 billion baht to strengthen border defense, including procurements of HIMARS rocket systems and long-range missiles, amid ongoing tensions.
title: Thailand boosts Cambodia border defense with 3.5bn baht allocation
titleTh: ไทยจัดสรรงบ 3.5 พันล้านบาท เสริมการป้องกันตามแนวชายแดนกัมพูชา

titleEn: Thailand allocates 3.5 billion baht to strengthen defenses along the Cambodia border

summary: Thai police, immigration, and border patrol officers arrested 26 undocumented Cambodian nationals during a raid on a community near the Rong Kluea border market in Sa Kaeo.
title: Thai authorities arrest 26 Cambodian nationals in Sa Kaeo border raid

summary: The Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs reaffirmed adherence to joint frameworks and urged Cambodia to halt unconstructive messaging and provocations in international forums to foster sustainable trust and peaceful resolution.
title: MFA reiterates Thailand's adherence to joint communique, urges Cambodia to stop using international platforms for unconstructive reporting

summary: Thailand reiterates commitment to ceasefire agreements while defending national actions against border scam operations, pushing back against international allegations.
title: Thailand rejects foreign claims at global stage, emphasizes self-defense against call center scam networks
